summary: Waucheesi Mountain lookout in Monroe County at 3,692 ft, shown on a 1957 map; the list marks it removed; a 2021 Forest Service project covers a communication tower.

facts.status_note: The Tennessee list marks the tower removed (note: 'cnf removed'). A 2021 Forest Service project covers a Waucheesi Communication Tower; no source reached ties it to the lookout site.

events.note: A USGS topographic map portrayed in 1957 and published in 1959 labels a Waucheesi Lookout Tower atop Waucheesi Mountain.
The Tennessee list marks the tower removed. No year is given.
The Forest Service signed a decision on 03/16/2021 for a project at a Waucheesi Communication Tower. The project page does not say it occupies the lookout site.

notes_for_editor: Brief status (gone) and elevation (1125.3 m, which matches 3,692 ft) agree with the list. No build year, design, staffing, fire history or closing year appears in the sources reached, so the story leaves them out. The 2021 project is the only record of current work on the mountain; it does not say the communication tower stands on the lookout's footprint. The list's 'cnf' tag is not explained by any source reached. Other listings spell the name 'Wauchessi' (anyplaceamerica, topozone); those pages were not readable or not fetched, so the list's spelling is used. The naturalatlas page returned no tower detail. Access is not stated, so no access fact is recorded.
